engines.E3: arXiv API export.arxiv.org/api/query (sortBy=submittedDate desc, 25 results; cs.CL/cs.LG/cs.AI not forced in query, applied at screening by window)
engines.E4: Semantic Scholar graph/v1/paper/search (year=2026, 25 results); also forward citations
engines.E6: grey literature via built-in WebSearch restricted to transformer-circuits.pub, lesswrong.com, alignmentforum.org, huggingface.co, github.com, neuronpedia.org, substack.com

round2: at most 6 queries built from vocabulary of included hits; motivating hit logged per query

snowballing.fallback: if 2609.06473 has 0 citations: backward references of 2609.06473 and 2606.03002
snowballing.swap_rule: swap a default only for a round-1 hit that scores higher on that lane; log the swap

O_object.1: which algorithm or solution strategy a code model writes
O_object.0.5: a categorical plan/strategy/attribute in another domain (reasoning strategy, rhyme, response length, language or library choice)

classes.P1: interchange or DAS with a declared map class
classes.P2: predicting effects of random directions from subspace projection or energy
classes.P3: interpolation or extrapolation along a causal variable
classes.P4: state noise against token temperature at matched departure
classes.P5: per-sample resampling of a fitted variable
classes.N: edit an explanation, reconstruct it and patch the result
classes.S: SAE or transcoder features against difference in means or prompting, with attribution
classes.E: same perturbations under activation-quantised and unquantised inference

C_criterion.1: validated by generation (emitted outputs scored by tests or labels)
C_criterion.0.5: logit, likelihood, probe or next-token readout

A_P1.FIRED: a paper localizes which algorithm or solution strategy a code LLM will use as a low-rank causal variable by interchange or DAS (a learned subspace patch) AND validates by generation (emitted programs change, scored by tests or labels)
A_P1.PARTLY_FIRED: only one half holds, or same work on a non-code strategy or on a code attribute that is not the algorithm (language or library)

B_E.FIRED: a paper shows activation quantization (FP8 or INT8 W8A8, or fake-quantised activations) changes the effect size of activation perturbations, steering or patching relative to bf16/fp16 on the same directions
B_E.PARTLY_FIRED: weight-only quantization (as in 2609.06473), or quantization that changes interpretability readouts (patching recovery, SAE features) without measuring perturbation effect sizes

C_N.FIRED: a paper edits NLA explanations, or the explanations of a similar verbaliser (LatentQA- or SelfIE-style decoder), and uses the result to steer the model
C_N.planner_precheck: the NLA paper itself does exactly this; expect FIRED on method; must be verified

D_P5.FIRED: a paper resamples a fitted, causally localised plan or latent variable once per generation to raise output diversity
D_P5.PARTLY_FIRED: per-sample activation noise or latent-code sampling without a fitted causal variable

contemporaneity_rule: inherited from 92d: arXiv v1 after 2026-06-22 -> contemporaneous_4mo; every ICLR 2027 submission -> contemporaneous; arXiv-only papers exempt from the ICLR rule
stop_rule: after round 2 plus snowballing, stop if no new hit scores >= 1.5; otherwise one round 3 (forward and backward references of new hits >= 1.5) inside the time cap
failure_handling: Semantic Scholar 429 -> back off and log; OpenAlex cites: not relied on
over time -> drop round 3, then E6 for L7, then forward citations beyond 2 neighbours; never drop flag seeds, QA or verdict box
